description_en: Updates a proprietary join permission owned by the current user account
description_zh: 调用UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermission更新当前用户账号所拥有的专用入网凭证
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan update-owned-local-join-permission --join-permission-id 123 --freq-band-plan-group-id 201 --class-mode A --join-permission-name '凭证1' --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the proprietary join permission to update
parameters.help_zh: 专用入网凭证ID，用来指定要更新的入网凭证
parameters.name: join_permission_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the frequency band used by the proprietary join permission. This parameter is used to update the existing frequency band
parameters.help_zh: 专用入网凭证所采用的频段的频段ID，用于更新旧频段
parameters.name: freq_band_plan_group_id

parameters.help_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the proprietary join permission. This parameter is used to update the existing Class mode. Valid values: A, B, and C
parameters.help_zh: 专用入网凭证采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，用于更新旧的 Class 模式。可取值：A、B、C
parameters.name: class_mode

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the join permission. This parameter is used to update the existing name
parameters.help_zh: 自定义入网凭证名称，用于更新旧名称
parameters.name: join_permission_name

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
